subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Segments oral sentences into individual words (claps on each word)

show.line: Sentences are made of words. Clap each word. I, like, my, dog. Four claps, four words!

rounds.prompt: Clap the words. The cat sat. How many words?
Clap the words. I can jump high. How many words?
Clap the parts of this word. Ba, na, na. How many claps? Say the number.
Clap the parts. Croc, o, dile. How many parts?
Which animal name has only one clap?
Clap the words. We go to school. How many words?
rounds.praise: Four words! We, go, to, school.

hints: Say the sentence slowly. Clap once for each word.
Count your claps on your fingers.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will clap the words. My dog runs.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! My, dog, runs. Three words, three claps.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's clap together. My, dog, runs. Three claps!

parent_line: Can clap the words in a sentence and the parts in a long word.
